The '''Moonflower Nebula''' was a [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] located within the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], near [[Pzob/Legends|Pzob]]. It was speckled with [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]].

{{Neb-stub}}

==History==
During its mission of destruction, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] battlemoon ''[[Eye of Palpatine]]'' was stopped by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Callista Ming]] and [[Geith Eris]] inside the nebula.
